title: Jagged Russian Beef Tagine
description: A rich and crunchy Russian dish featuring ginger paste, cooked in a tagine and served on a lazy-susan-spinner, perfect for curing hangovers. This low-sodium-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional Russian cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the beef brisket pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger paste, prunes, beef broth, and salt-free seasoning blend, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the Jagged Russian Beef Tagine on a lazy-susan-spinner, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
